title: Steric-Pressure-Driven Topological Reconstruction for High-Performance Zintl Phase Thermoelectrics with Machine-Learning Validation.
summary: The study reports a synthesized and measured Zintl-phase reconstruction with improved thermoelectric performance, where CrabNet and XGBoost rank a specific materials region and contribute to the result. The full text identifies the experimental material, the measured thermoelectric outcome and the model validation, but the exact validation protocol is not fully described there, so the interpretation stays with the demonstrated result.
